benchmark: STACK Analytics Assistant - educator query benchmark
globalFaithfulnessCriteria: Numerical values agree with the backend output.
Rankings and comparisons agree with the backend output.
States whether the evidence concerns the error-response subset or the complete cohort.
Provisional NEA labels are not presented as certain observations of student cognition.
Criterion-based screening is not described as predictive risk classification.
Higher item facility is interpreted as easier performance on the item.
Discrimination is described as a review indicator, not an automatic judgement of item quality.
No causal claims beyond the returned evidence.
globalProhibitedInterpretations: Presenting the mean of stored rows as the cohort's average grade.
Presenting provisional NEA labels as verified cognitive diagnoses.
Describing support-priority matches as predicted failure or risk.
Inventing counts not present in tool output.
